property_hierarchy.property_comment: Top header band: 'Randomization' (V3 only), 'Double-Blind Treatment' spanning V4-V7, 'Early Discontinuation' (ED), 'Follow-up' (V801; printed 'Follow- / up'). Typed by the value that spans several columns (a study phase) -> epoch; single-column values stay values of the band. The label cell prints the table heading 'H0P-MC-NP03 ISA', so the name is synthesised.
Visit identifiers V3-V7, ED, V801 -> visit.
Study week per visit: 0, 2, 4, 6, 8; blank for ED and V801 -> week.
Allowed deviation in days: blank for V3, '±3' in each of V4-V7 (four ruled cells), blank for ED and V801 -> window; a qualifier of the columns, so hierarchical_level null.

Shaded, bold-labelled row printed with the header on every page: 'X' with footnotes a, b in the V3 column and 'X' with footnote c in the V801 column, the rest blank. Footnote c: Visit 801 occurs 4-10 days after last dose of study intervention; footnotes a and b are redacted (in OA03 and BP03 they place two telephone visits 4 and 8 days after Visit 3). Typed visit_attribute (a mark on a visit column that says the visit or its interval is by telephone, like a fasting row); it does not tell columns apart, so hierarchical_level null. Whether it is a header row at all is review item D1.

unified_annotations.annotation_text: This SoA shows visits and procedures unique to the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-NP03 (NP03) for LY3556050. Please refer to master protocol and the DPNP DSA SoAs for additional information.
Visit window +2 days

Definition not printed in the source: in the Telephone Visit Notes cell, the two lines after the visit-window line, each opening with a superscript marker, are covered by redaction boxes labelled 'CCI'. Probable equivalent, not source content: OA03 and BP03 define a as 'Visit occurs 4 days after Visit 3'. [remainder redacted in source]

Definition not printed in the source: in the Telephone Visit Notes cell, the two lines after the visit-window line, each opening with a superscript marker, are covered by redaction boxes labelled 'CCI'. Probable equivalent, not source content: OA03 and BP03 define b as 'Visit occurs 8 days after Visit 3'. [remainder redacted in source]
Visit 801 occurs 4-10 days after last dose of study intervention.
V3-V7: Do symptom-directed physical examination
V3, V5, and V7: Single safety ECG before in-clinic dosing and at 3 hours after dosing
V4, V6 and ED: Single ECG
ECG includes collection of PR interval, QRS duration and interval, and heart rate.

Blood Pressure and Pulse Rate
Collect orthostatic blood pressure after 5 minutes supine and then 2-3 minutes after standing and collect pulse after supine and standing blood pressure.
Temperature and Respiratory rate
Collect once at each visit
V3, V5, and V7: Collect blood pressure and pulse in supine and standing position before in-clinic dosing and at 3 hours after dosing
V4, V6, and ED: Collect blood pressure once

Intervention is taken orally, twice daily (BID), approximately every 12 hours.
Refer to Section 6.6 for dose titration scheme.
V3, V5, and V7: Participants take the morning dose in the clinic.
V3: Collect laboratory tests before dosing.
Performed at investigator discretion.
For WOCBP only

For WOCBP only
Collect sample within 24 hours prior to first dose.
V3: Collect at 3 hours ±15 minutes after dosing.
V5 and V7: Collect samples before dosing and at 3 hours ±15 minutes after dosing.
V4, V6, and ED: Collect single sample at any time.
Record date and time of collection.
Not printed in the source: the Notes cell of this row is covered by a redaction box labelled 'CCI'. [remainder redacted in source]

review_items.call_made: The shaded 'Telephone Visit' row, printed with the header on every page, is recorded as header row 5 (schedule_property, visit_attribute, level null) with 'X' + footnotes a, b in the V3 grid cell and 'X' + footnote c in the V801 grid cell. Footnote c ('Visit 801 occurs 4-10 days after last dose of study intervention.') suggests V801 itself is a telephone visit; a and b are redacted.
review_items.alternative: Record it as an activity row 'Telephone Visit' with marks at V3 and V801 (counted once), or treat the telephone visits behind a and b as visits of their own between V3 and V4 (not printed as columns).
